You see a fire sword (Atk:24 physical +11 fire, Def:20 +1).
Classification: 2 Tier: 0.
It can only be wielded properly by players of level 30 or higher.
It weighs 23.00 oz.
The blade is a magic flame.

    Notes

    • Can be obtained in the Orc Fortress Quest.
    • Three Fire Swords can be traded for a Magic Sulphur with Haroun or Yaman.

    Weapon Proficiency

    1 2 3 4
    +1 defence modifier
    +4% of your Sword Fighting as extra damage for auto-attacks
    +2% critical hit chance for auto-attacks
    +5 mana on kill
    +2% damage against Undead

    History

    • The graphic for the Fire Sword is an edit of the old Rapier sprite.
    • Dragons used to drop these swords.
    • With the 2012 Spring Patch the sprite of the Fire Sword changed from to .
